rules.description: Record the selected electrical standard edition and its primary source before notation approval.
Record the exact IEC 60617 reference number and source for every semantic symbol before notation approval.
Record orientation and named port roles for every electrical symbol used by a conductor.
Record conductor type, source and target ports, and whether each crossing is connected or unconnected.
Render connected and crossing-without-connection conductors unambiguously.
Use a verified licensed symbol source or live MCP match; never substitute a similar generic icon.
The live transformer style has no IEC 60617 reference in the MCP result and remains a candidate until mapped to the selected standard.
